The '''Stewjon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of [[Colstev]] and [[Stewjon/Legends|Stewjon]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Kenobi family/Legends|family]], which consisted of his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's mother/Legends|mother]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's father/Legends|father]].<ref name="JATHP" />
